in_marathi.name: Vijoy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vijay: The one who is victorious and triumphant. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijaya', which means victory. It is a powerful and strong name that symbolizes success and triumph in all aspects of life.
